implement_Consumer: implement a concrete class that extends the Consumer abstract base class for stream processing
implement_Consumer_consume: implement the consume method of Consumer to accept and process a single value from a stream
implement_Consumer_terminate: implement the terminate method of Consumer to signal that no more values will be supplied
implement_Consumer_consume_and_terminate: implement the consume_and_terminate method of Consumer to supply a final value and end the stream
review_Consumer: review the Consumer abstract base class and its three abstract methods for stream consumption
